title: a step is auto where a connector will run it, and its rationale names the sources searched by hand
line: the cemetery row of a deceased man names two sources, Find a Grave, which no connector searches, and the VA gravesite locator, which one does: the step is auto because the loop searches the locator, and its rationale says the loop searches there and the owner by hand at Find a Grave; a living person's step is assisted at both sources

steps.say: Francis Thomas Ahearn, no cemetery record cited: his baseline reviewed, and deceased on the owner's word so the plan can write his searches

living.note: harness: so the steps are auto

has: searched by the loop at VA Nationwide Gravesite Locator
by hand at Find a Grave

expect.why: the loop asks the locator and never Find a Grave: the step's mode is auto and its rationale says who searches where

steps.say: the same person, the owner's word that he is living: the plan is written again

living.note: harness: a living person's searches are the owner's

expect.why: no source is one the loop asks for a living person: the step is assisted and says nothing of the loop
